name: TC-PSH-04: View All Used Trucks link does not reuse a product card's URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/PopularSecondHandTruck.cy.js#Homepage - PopularSecondHandTruck [en] TC-PSH-04: View All Used Trucks link does not reuse a product card's URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PSH-04
**Title:** View All Used Trucks link does not reuse a product card's URL
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm the View All Used Trucks link does not accidentally point at the first product card's PDP URL.

**Expected Result:**
View All Used Trucks and the first product card link to different URLs.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Second Hand Truck
2. Verify View All's href differs from the first product's href
